==Description==
'''Bones''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Trick or Threat Town]] as part of the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]. They were slightly slower than the [[Mummy (Trick or Threat Town)|Mummy]] and slightly faster than the [[Undead (Trick or Threat Town)|Undead]]. '''Bones''' also had more health than these two enemies.

'''Bones''' could be spawned by the [[Reaper (Trick or Threat Town)|Reaper]].

==Appearance==
The '''Bones''' was entirely made out of marble white parts that resembled a skeleton. It did not have a full torso, but instead had the bone cage for it. Its head was slightly smaller than usual and had two large black eyes. It had a slightly different walking animation to the [[Undead (Trick or Threat Town)|Undead]] and [[Mummy (Trick or Threat Town)|Mummy]].

==Strategy==
*These are relatively easy to defeat, so long you have the capabilities of defeating the [[Mummy (Trick or Threat Town)|Mummy]] and [[Undead (Trick or Threat Town)|Undead]] that appears before this.
*As they can spawn in hordes, splash-damage towers, like the [[Rocketeer]], can help in defeating these enemies.

==Trivia==
*The '''Bones''' had a death animation where it would fall into a pile of bones and its head would roll a short distance.
*The '''Bones''' would have cracks on its body the more it got damaged. It also became slightly darker in color.
